mechanism: oral targeted-release budesonide (locally acting corticosteroid; relative-bioavailability study vs Tarpeyo and Budenofalk)
indications: IgA nephropathy|autoimmune hepatitis
latest_data: Placebo-controlled Phase 2 in primary IgAN (NCT05016323, start Sep 2021) and open-label Phase 2 in autoimmune hepatitis (NCT05476900) completed; results not located offline.
notes: HR-prefixed Hengrui code; all trials China-only. NCT06922305 compares HR19042 capsules with budesonide delayed-release (Tarpeyo) and enteric capsules, so HR19042 is a budesonide formulation (Nefecon-like). Offline verification only (web search budget exhausted).

sponsor: Chia Tai Tianqing Pharmaceutical Group (Sino Biopharmaceutical)
indications: myelofibrosis|chronic graft-versus-host disease
latest_data: Phase 3 (NCT06682169, started Nov 2024) in 3L+ moderate-severe cGVHD vs investigator's choice; Phase 2 MF data (post-ruxolitinib and JAKi-naive cohorts) presented at ASH 2023-2024 showing SVR35 responses; new Phase 2 MF study NCT07551427 planned 2026.
first_in_class_note: First JAK/ROCK dual inhibitor in late-stage development
notes: ChEMBL5314485 synonym tq05105. A China NDA for MF was reportedly submitted in 2024 but could not be verified offline. Offline verification only.

indications: HR+/HER2- advanced breast cancer (1L with letrozole/anastrozole; post-endocrine with fulvestrant)
latest_data: Phase 3 XZP-3287 + letrozole/anastrozole vs placebo in 1L HR+/HER2- recurrent/metastatic BC (NCT05257395, started Mar 2022) active, not recruiting; a separate Phase 3 with fulvestrant reportedly met its PFS endpoint and supported a China NDA (2024, unverified).
notes: Xuanzhu Biopharm is the innovative-drug subsidiary of Sihuan Pharmaceutical (Hong Kong-listed). NDA status unverified offline. Offline verification only.

indications: solid tumors|lymphoma|metastatic colorectal cancer|non-small cell lung cancer (1L with serplulimab + chemo)
latest_data: Phase 2 in 4L+ mCRC with serplulimab (NCT05584137) terminated; Phase 2 in 1L NSCLC with serplulimab + chemotherapy (NCT05787613, start Jul 2023) active, not recruiting; no efficacy readout located offline.
notes: OpenTargets maps HLX26 to the INN relatlimab, but HLX26 is Henlius' own anti-LAG-3 mAb (trial text calls it first-in-class), not a relatlimab biosimilar. Offline verification only.

mechanism: anti-ST2 monoclonal antibody blocking IL-33 signalling
indications: chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
latest_data: Phase 1b/2a in moderate-severe COPD (NCT06175351) completed enrolment; randomized placebo-controlled Phase 2 in COPD (NCT07292714) started Jul 2025.
first_in_class_note: Among the first anti-ST2 antibodies from a Chinese company (class precedent: astegolimab, tozorakimab)
notes: Offline verification only.

indications: relapsed/refractory DLBCL (with R-GemOx)|CLL/SLL|B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma
latest_data: Randomized Phase 2 HMPL-760 + R-GemOx vs placebo + R-GemOx in R/R DLBCL (NCT06601504, start Nov 2024) active; Phase 3 in the same setting (NCT07409428) started Mar 2026. Phase 1 in R/R B-NHL completed.
first_in_class_note: Non-covalent BTKi retaining activity against C481S resistance; Phase 3 in DLBCL is a differentiated setting for the class
notes: HUTCHMED is headquartered in Hong Kong with R&D in Shanghai (counts as CN per project definition). Offline verification only.

indications: FGFR2/3-altered solid tumors (incl. urothelial)|achondroplasia (pediatric)
latest_data: Phase 2 ABSK061 + ABSK043 (oral PD-L1 inhibitor) +/- chemo in FGFR2/3-altered solid tumors (NCT06632262, start Nov 2024); pediatric Phase 1/2 in achondroplasia (NCT07297875) planned Dec 2025; mini-tablet PK study in healthy adults 2025.
notes: Offline verification only.

mechanism: anti-BAFF-R monoclonal antibody (B-cell depleting/BAFF signalling blockade)
indications: B-cell lymphoid malignancies|immune thrombocytopenia|primary Sjogren's syndrome
latest_data: Phase 1 in B-cell malignancies (NCT05822843) completed; Phase 1/2 in primary ITP (NCT06853444) started May 2025; placebo-controlled Phase 2 in primary Sjogren's (NCT07375524) planned Mar 2026.
notes: Sponsor assigned from the ESG code prefix (Escugen also uses ESG401 TROP2 ADC); company identity not web-verified. Program pivoted from oncology to autoimmune indications. Offline verification only.

target: oncolytic HSV-1 expressing IL-12 and IL-15/IL-15Ra
mechanism: dual-regulated oncolytic herpes simplex virus-1 armed with IL-12 and IL-15 (intratumoral/intraperitoneal)
indications: advanced solid tumors|colorectal cancer liver metastases (with ivonescimab)|intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma
latest_data: Phase 1 dose-escalation studies completed in China and the US with no DLTs and no MTD reached (per NCT07522476 description); Phase 1b/2 with ivonescimab (AK112) in CRC liver metastases and Phase 2a in intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma planned for 2026.
notes: Virogin Biotech is Chinese-founded with corporate presence in Vancouver, Canada and R&D/manufacturing in Shanghai (Shanghai Virogin); classified CN under the project's Chinese-founded/R&D-in-China rule, confidence medium. Offline verification only.

indications: head and neck squamous cell carcinoma|oral dysplasia|glioblastoma/high-grade glioma
notes: Code-prefix collision with Ascentage Pharma (APG-xxx); APG-157 is a US botanical drug from Aveta Biomics (expanded-access record describes it as a botanical drug). Offline verification only.

indications: primary hypercholesterolemia and mixed dyslipidemia|heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia|atherosclerotic cerebrovascular disease (IIT)|MSS colorectal cancer (IIT with toripalimab)
latest_data: Phase 3 in HeFH (NCT05325203) and Phase 3 monotherapy in primary hypercholesterolemia/mixed dyslipidemia (NCT05621070, n=582; 150 mg Q2W and 450 mg Q4W) showed ~60-70% LDL-C reduction vs placebo; BLA accepted by NMPA in 2024 and, per recollection, approved in 2025.
notes: ChEMBL4594566 (JS002). Approval status (2025) is from recollection and could not be verified offline; BLA filing is certain. New investigator-initiated trials in stroke prevention (ORIS, NCT07242599) and oncology combos. Offline verification only.

indications: HR+/HER2- advanced breast cancer (with fulvestrant; with AI)|early breast cancer|HER2+ breast cancer (IIT with pyrotinib)|metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer (with abiraterone)
latest_data: Approved in China Dec 2021 (DAWNA-1: + fulvestrant, mPFS 15.7 vs 7.2 mo) and 2023 for 1L with AI (DAWNA-2: mPFS 30.6 vs 18.2 mo, Lancet Oncol 2023). Ongoing Phase 1b/3 in high-volume mHSPC with abiraterone (NCT06099990) and combos with SHR-A1811 and HRS-1358.
first_in_class_note: First domestically developed CDK4/6 inhibitor approved in China (brand Airuikang)
notes: ChEMBL4802161, maximum stage APPROVAL. Offline verification only.

indications: mild-to-moderate COVID-19
latest_data: NEJM 2024 Phase 2/3 (NCT05506176, n=1208): simnotrelvir/ritonavir shortened time to sustained symptom resolution by ~1.5 days vs placebo (180.1 vs 216.0 h) in mild-to-moderate COVID-19; conditional NMPA approval Jan 2023 (Xiannuoxin).
first_in_class_note: First domestic oral 3CLpro inhibitor approved in China
notes: ChEMBL5570561 lists trade name component of Xiannuoxin (simnotrelvir + ritonavir). Offline verification only.

mechanism: urate-lowering agent tested head-to-head against febuxostat at the same doses (febuxostat-based reformulation/derivative inferred)
indications: gout with hyperuricemia
latest_data: Phase 3 vs febuxostat in gout with hyperuricemia (NCT06139393, start Dec 2023) completed; second Phase 3 (NCT06414837) registered; batch-comparability PK study in healthy subjects completed 2025, consistent with pre-NDA activity.
notes: Mechanism not disclosed in registry text; the same-dose comparison with febuxostat suggests an improved febuxostat product rather than a new chemical entity. Offline verification only.

mechanism: lipid-nanoparticle mRNA vaccine encoding SARS-CoV-2 spike antigen (Omicron-adapted versions developed)
indications: COVID-19 prevention (booster)
latest_data: Phase 1 (adults 18-59 and >=60) and Phase 2 immunogenicity studies in 2022; included for emergency use in China in March 2023 as the first domestic mRNA COVID-19 vaccine; used as booster in a 2023 platform trial (NCT05855408).
first_in_class_note: First mRNA COVID-19 vaccine granted emergency use in China
notes: 'Approved (China)' reflects emergency-use inclusion (Mar 2023), not a full BLA. Commercial relevance now limited. Offline verification only.

indications: severe hypertriglyceridemia|MASLD/MetALD with fibrosis risk|obesity|hypertriglyceridemia with carotid plaque (IIT)
latest_data: Placebo-controlled Phase 2 in severe hypertriglyceridemia (NCT06555640, 12-week TG endpoint, weekly SC dosing) completed 2025; Phase 2 in MASLD/MetALD at high fibrosis risk (NCT07024212) active, not recruiting.
notes: Mechanism confirmed from registry description. Phase 1 was run in New Zealand/Australia. Offline verification only.

sponsor: Chia Tai Tianqing Pharmaceutical Group (Sino Biopharmaceutical)
mechanism: biparatopic anti-HER2 bispecific antibody (dual HER2 epitope blockade)
indications: HER2-positive advanced breast cancer (3L+, with chemo)|HER2-expressing solid tumors (with TQB2102 HER2 ADC)
latest_data: Phase 3 TQB2930 + investigator's-choice chemo vs trastuzumab + chemo in HER2+ ABC after >=2 anti-HER2 lines (NCT07047365, started Jul 2025); Phase 1b/2 in HER2+ mBC ongoing; combination with TQB2102 planned 2026.
notes: Mechanism confirmed from registry description. Offline verification only.

mechanism: bifunctional antibody blocking CD39 ectonucleotidase and trapping TGF-beta
indications: advanced solid tumors|myxofibrosarcoma|malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor|malignant pleural mesothelioma|desmoid tumors
latest_data: Phase 1 (NCT05717348) active, not recruiting; single-arm Phase 2 in selected sarcomas/mesothelioma (NCT06543056, start Nov 2024) and multicenter Phase 2 in desmoid tumors (NCT07541430, 2026) recruiting.
first_in_class_note: First-in-class CD39 x TGF-beta bifunctional antibody
notes: Target assignment from prior knowledge of Elpiscience pipeline (not stated in registry text). Offline verification only.

indications: moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis|cutaneous lupus erythematosus
latest_data: Phase 2 in moderate-severe plaque psoriasis (NCT06109818) reported 2024: PASI 75 at week 12 of roughly 78% at 6 mg and 9 mg BID vs ~6% placebo (approximate, from recollection); Phase 3 in psoriasis (NCT06842199) started Mar 2025; Phase 2 in CLE planned 2026.
first_in_class_note: Best-in-class positioning vs deucravacitinib on potency/selectivity
notes: Phase 2 figures approximate. Offline verification only.

indications: CLDN18.2-positive gastric/GEJ adenocarcinoma (2L+ monotherapy; 1L with toripalimab + XELOX)|pancreatic cancer
latest_data: Phase 3 JS107 vs investigator's choice in 2L+ CLDN18.2+ G/GEJ (NCT07284134) started Dec 2025; Phase 3 JS107 + toripalimab + XELOX vs sintilimab + XELOX in 1L (NCT07584135) planned 2026; Phase 1 monotherapy/toripalimab combination data in solid tumors and pancreatic cancer.
notes: Offline verification only.

mechanism: generic drug-class term (anti-PD-1 immune checkpoint blockade), not a specific asset
indications: Hodgkin lymphoma|esophageal carcinoma|nasopharyngeal carcinoma
notes: Not an asset: intervention recorded as the class term 'PD-1 blockade' in investigator-initiated trials (Chinese NPC/esophageal studies and a European R/R Hodgkin lymphoma study). Seed mapping to Innovent/sintilimab is an artifact of OpenTargets synonym matching; no sponsor can be assigned. Offline verification only.

mechanism: undisclosed; used as an endocrine-backbone-type agent in HR+ breast cancer alongside fulvestrant/letrozole/HRS-8080 (oral SERD) and combined with dalpiciclib, HRS-6209 and SHR2554
indications: metastatic/locally advanced breast cancer (HR+)
latest_data: Phase 1 monotherapy / + dalpiciclib (NCT05628870, start Feb 2023) recruiting; Phase 1b/2 combination umbrella studies with HRS-6209, HRS-8080, HRS-2189 (2024-2025); investigator-initiated Phase 2 with SHR2554 (EZH2 inhibitor) planned.
notes: HRS-prefixed Hengrui code; target not disclosed in registry text and not confirmable offline (positioning parallel to fulvestrant/letrozole/HRS-8080 suggests an ER-directed agent, unverified). Offline verification only.

indications: advanced solid tumors|non-small cell lung cancer|breast cancer (with MHB039A PD-1 x VEGF)
latest_data: Phase 1/2 dose escalation/expansion (NCT06373406) active, not recruiting; Phase 2 MHB036C + MHB039A in advanced breast cancer/solid tumors (NCT07130383, Sep 2025) and Phase 1/2 in advanced lung cancer with MHB039A or furmonertinib/chemo (NCT07229599) recruiting.
first_in_class_note: Among the leading PTK7-directed ADCs after Pfizer's cofetuzumab pelidotin
notes: Target from prior knowledge of Minghui pipeline. Offline verification only.

indications: advanced solid tumors|HER2-negative gastric/GEJ adenocarcinoma (1L with chemo +/- cadonilimab)|classic Hodgkin lymphoma after PD-1 failure (+/- AK117 anti-CD47)|NSCLC|HNSCC|colorectal cancer
latest_data: Phase 1a/1b monotherapy (NCT05645276) recruiting since Mar 2023; multiple Phase 1b/2 combination studies opened 2024-2025 in G/GEJ, cHL and solid tumors; no efficacy readout located offline.
notes: Mechanism confirmed from registry titles. Offline verification only.

sponsor: Chia Tai Tianqing Pharmaceutical Group (Sino Biopharmaceutical)
mechanism: BCMA x CD3 T-cell-engaging bispecific antibody (IgG1)
indications: relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma|systemic light-chain (AL) amyloidosis
latest_data: Phase 1 IV (NCT05646758) and SC formulation (NCT07179679) studies in MM; registrational Phase 1b/2 in AL amyloidosis (NCT07266116, Dec 2025); randomized Phase 3 vs investigator's choice (selinexor/pomalidomide-based) in R/R MM (NCT07569757, n=260) planned mid-2026.
notes: Mechanism confirmed from registry description. Offline verification only.

mechanism: anti-TIGIT antibody fused to TGF-beta receptor II trap (bifunctional fusion protein)
indications: advanced solid tumors|hepatocellular carcinoma|biliary tract cancer|pancreatic cancer (all with ivonescimab AK112)
latest_data: Phase 1 monotherapy (NCT05653284) completed; Phase 1b/2 AK130 + ivonescimab in BTC (NCT06938321) and Phase 2 in pancreatic cancer (NCT07114315, Sep 2025) recruiting; also an arm in the AK112 HCC combination platform study.
first_in_class_note: First TIGIT/TGF-beta bifunctional fusion protein in clinic
notes: ChEMBL6068134 (lucorafusp alfa). Offline verification only.

indications: myelodysplastic syndrome|chronic myelomonocytic leukemia (+/- azacitidine)|hepatocellular carcinoma (with durvalumab +/- tremelimumab)
latest_data: Phase 1 monotherapy and Phase 1b + azacitidine in MDS/CMML (2023, status unknown); Phase 1b/2 with durvalumab in HCC (NCT06111326) not yet recruiting; US Phase 1b/2 with STRIDE regimen (NCT06608940) withdrawn.
notes: Registry text describes BC3402 as a novel anti-TIM3 agent; sponsor inferred from the BC-prefix used by BioCity Biopharma (e.g., BC3195), not web-verified. Several trial statuses are UNKNOWN/withdrawn, so activity is unclear. Offline verification only.

indications: pathological scar (keloid/hypertrophic scar)|advanced solid tumors|fibrotic diseases
latest_data: First-in-human SAD studies in healthy adults (Australia and China, 2023) completed; Phase 1 in solid tumors; randomized placebo-controlled Phase 2 in pathological scar (NCT07576608) started Dec 2025.
first_in_class_note: One of the first anti-IL-11 antibodies to enter clinical development globally
notes: Target from prior knowledge of Mabwell pipeline. Offline verification only.

indications: advanced solid tumors|MSS/pMMR colorectal cancer (1L with JS207 + XELOX)|pancreatic cancer (platform trial)
latest_data: Phase 1 monotherapy (NCT05770310) and Phase 1b/2 combination study with chemo/toripalimab (NCT06139211) ongoing; Phase 2 JS207 (PD-1 x VEGF) +/- JS015 + XELOX in 1L MSS mCRC (NCT06885385) started Apr 2025.
notes: Target from prior knowledge of Junshi pipeline. Offline verification only.

mechanism: undisclosed; combined with endocrine agents (+/- fluvastatin) in breast cancer, with HRS-5041 in prostate cancer and with adebrelimab + bevacizumab biosimilar in colorectal cancer
indications: advanced solid tumors|breast cancer|metastatic prostate cancer|metastatic colorectal cancer
latest_data: Phase 1 monotherapy dose escalation/expansion in solid tumors (NCT05851092, 2023); Phase 1b/2 combinations in breast cancer (NCT06679036, 2025); investigator-initiated Phase 2 studies in prostate (with HRS-5041) and colorectal cancer planned.
notes: Mechanism not disclosed in registry text and not resolvable offline. Offline verification only.

indications: relapsed/refractory acute myeloid leukemia|AML (with 7+3 or venetoclax + azacitidine)|relapsed/refractory myelodysplastic syndromes
latest_data: Phase 1 monotherapy studies in R/R AML (NCT05924750, NCT06714591) recruiting; Phase 2/3 combination with cytarabine + daunorubicin or venetoclax + azacitidine (NCT07255872) and Phase 1b/2 in R/R MDS planned 2026.
notes: Target from prior knowledge of Baili-Bio pipeline (BL-Mxx D1 ADC series). Offline verification only.

mechanism: generic drug-class term (anti-PD-1 antibodies), not a specific asset
indications: colorectal cancer|hepatocellular carcinoma|advanced malignancies
notes: Not an asset: class term used in Chinese investigator-initiated/retrospective studies (Hunan Cancer Hospital etc.) and an erythrocyte-conjugated anti-PD-1 IIT. Seed mapping to Innovent/sintilimab is an OpenTargets synonym artifact. Offline verification only.

indications: insomnia disorder
latest_data: Phase 1b/2 PSG-based study in Chinese adults with insomnia (NCT06279286, 2024) completed; Phase 3 placebo-controlled study on LPS and WASO (NCT07587385) planned May 2026; itraconazole DDI study 2026.
notes: HS-10xxx is the Hansoh code series. Mechanism (DORA) from recollection of Hansoh pipeline disclosures; not verifiable offline. Offline verification only.

indications: moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis|psoriatic arthritis|palmoplantar pustulosis (IIT)
latest_data: Phase 3 CLEAR-1 in plaque psoriasis (2024) showed high PASI 90/sPGA 0-1 response at week 16 vs placebo with durable maintenance; NDA accepted by NMPA late 2024. Phase 3 switch study after IL-17 inadequate response (NCT06945107, 2025) and Phase 2/3 in PsA (NCT07295509, Dec 2025) ongoing.
notes: ChEMBL5314763 (ibi112). China approval may have occurred in 2025-2026 but could not be verified offline; NDA acceptance (Dec 2024) is from recollection. Offline verification only.

mechanism: anti-PD-L1 antibody fused to VEGF trap (bispecific antibody-receptor fusion)
indications: non-small cell lung cancer (1L with chemo)|triple-negative breast cancer|hepatocellular carcinoma|advanced solid tumors (with IMM27M anti-CTLA-4; with IMM01 anti-CD47)
latest_data: Phase 1 dose escalation/expansion (NCT05972460) completed; Phase 2 IMM2510 + chemo 1L in NSCLC/TNBC (NCT06746870); Phase 1 with IMM27M (NCT06764836, 2024) recruiting; Phase 1b/2 with IMM01 planned.
notes: ChEMBL6068162 (palverafusp alfa). Mechanism confirmed from registry description. Offline verification only.

mechanism: CDK4/6 inhibitor (antitumor with fulvestrant in HR+ BC; chemo-combination/myeloprotection-style use in TNBC)
indications: HR+/HER2- locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer (with fulvestrant)|advanced triple-negative breast cancer (with carboplatin + gemcitabine)
latest_data: Phase 3 BEBT-209 + fulvestrant vs placebo + fulvestrant in HR+/HER2- ABC after endocrine progression (NCT06998108, started Jun 2022) recruiting; Phase 2 in TNBC with carboplatin/gemcitabine (NCT06685796) and Phase 2b/3 in TNBC (NCT07544056, 2026).
notes: Mechanism (CDK4/6) from prior knowledge of BeBetter pipeline. Offline verification only.

indications: advanced clear cell renal cell carcinoma (mono; with lenvatinib)|VHL disease-associated tumors
latest_data: Phase 1a/1b in ccRCC (NCT06049030, 2023) and Phase 1 in VHL-associated tumors (NCT06553339, 2024); Phase 1b/2 HS-10516 + lenvatinib in previously treated ccRCC (NCT07097935) started Jul 2025.
notes: Mechanism from prior knowledge of Hansoh pipeline (VHL + ccRCC program is characteristic of HIF-2a inhibitors). Offline verification only.

mechanism: anti-DLL3 antibody-drug conjugate (topoisomerase-I inhibitor payload, MediLink TMALIN platform)
indications: relapsed small cell lung cancer (mono; with atezolizumab +/- carboplatin; with tarlatamab +/- durvalumab)|DLL3-expressing neuroendocrine/solid tumors
latest_data: ASCO 2025 update of Phase 1 (NCT06179069): ORR ~68% in previously treated ES-SCLC with manageable safety and CNS activity (approximate figures); FDA Breakthrough Therapy Designation 2025. Randomized Phase 3 vs investigator's choice in relapsed SCLC (NCT07218146) started Nov 2025; Phase 1b with tarlatamab 2026.
first_in_class_note: Potential best-in-class DLL3 ADC; FDA BTD in ES-SCLC
notes: Zai Lab is headquartered in Shanghai (with Cambridge, MA operations) and holds global rights. ASCO 2025 figures approximate. Offline verification only.

sponsor: Chia Tai Tianqing Pharmaceutical Group (Sino Biopharmaceutical)

mechanism: EGFR-directed antibody (IV and subcutaneous formulations); exact format (monospecific vs EGFR x cMET bispecific) not verified

latest_data: Phase 1 IV (NCT06188624, 2024) and SC (NCT07260708, Dec 2025) studies recruiting; Phase 1b/2 with TAS-102 +/- bevacizumab in chemo-refractory RAS/BRAF-WT mCRC (NCT07044908, Jul 2025); Phase 1b/2 SC in R/M HNC planned 2026.
notes: Target inferred from indication pattern; not stated in registry text and not verifiable offline. Offline verification only.

indications: HER2-expressing advanced solid tumors|non-small cell lung cancer|advanced cervical cancer (with platinum chemo +/- bevacizumab)
latest_data: First-in-human Phase 1/2 (NCT06226766, Australia) terminated; China Phase 1/2 (NCT06770881) and Phase 2 studies in NSCLC (NCT07283198, Dec 2025) and cervical cancer (NCT07497074, 2026) registered.

notes: Composition from prior knowledge of Alphamab disclosures. Offline verification only.
